effectgroup.name: OuzFX AFX_Move_Whip_Slide_Out_Left
effectgroup.description: Whip-slide OUT to the left: accelerates off-screen (expo ease-in) while directional motion blur builds up – the exact mirror of 'Anim · Slide In from Left' (12 frames). Razor 12 frames before the end of the clip and drop it on that last piece – the layer is gone on the last frame (anything after stays hidden). Faster 6–8 frame camera-push tier: 'Fast · Motion-Blur Push Left' / 'AFX_Cam_Whip_Pan_Push_*'.
